title: Kamishiro Rui — Profile Story

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay. Last but not least, me.
I consider it an honor to be the headliner.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please allow me to introduce myself once again. I'm Rui Kamishiro from Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've probably seen me perform on stage many times now, but I'm primarily more of a director.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Also...
I enjoy making props and gadgets for our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, we have a launch pad that will send you flying sky-high, and a lifeline that lets you fall from such heights.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I even invented our trusted companion, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, I'm starting to sound more like an inventor instead of a director, aren't I...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I believe in doing what I can to make our shows as entertaining as possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Currently, I get to have fun with the others. But until not too long ago, I was doing shows all by myself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Very few people were able to understand my directing style...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the others in Wonderlands×Showtime were willing to listen. To accept me for who I am.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They believed that my ideas would make their shows better.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I respect their attitude when it comes to shows, and I could not be more grateful to them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just as Tsukasa and Emu said, we're going to leave the Wonder Stage to set out into the world...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may face some high hurdles in the future.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm very excited because this is uncharted territory for us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Moreover, I'm beyond overjoyed that we get to keep pursuing our dreams while doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how the others grow, as well as myself. So, let's all keep doing our best...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I believe that's it for me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My self-introduction sort of turned into me cheering on the others.
